newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Chinese tourists escape kidnappers in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Chinese tourists escape kidnappers in Cambodia.

text.p: A group of 17 Chinese tourists were kidnapped, held for a week in captivity and escaped after stabbing to death one of their abductors and seriously beating another, police and the Chinese Embassy said on Friday.
A spokesman said the embassy was seeking to repatriate the 12 men and five women, who are from Fujian province.
He said the group had been on a tour of the region that included trips to Thailand and Malaysia when they were kidnapped in Phnom Penh by five Chinese suspected of being gangsters.

The tourists had told the embassy they were held in cramped quarters in a Phnom Penh guest house for a week while the kidnappers tried to extract ransom from their families in China, the spokesman said.
When the captors let down their guard on Thursday morning, the hostages stabbed and killed one of them and beat another, who remains hospitalised, before fleeing to the embassy, said the spokesman.
District police confirmed the embassy spokesman's account and said three suspects were still at large.
